shorts.title: Scientists Counted 63 Tapeworm Larvae in One Oarfish

shorts.description: Researchers in Mexico found 63 tapeworm larvae in a single giant oarfish's gut, waiting for a mako shark; see Doug's full oarfish episode linked below.
